title: Structure-based virulence factor classification using a dual-driven graph transformer with a pretrained language model.
authors: Bai, Peihao; Li, Guanghui; Jiang, Nan; Chen, Jiao; Liang, Cheng; Ding, Yijie
one_liner_zh: 该文提出基于蛋白结构图与预训练语言模型的双驱动图Transformer框架SDGT，用于细菌毒力因子分类，虽对象非典型结构计算问题，但方法上结合结构图表示与AI，对蛋白质结构表征学习有借鉴意义。
abstract: Bacterial pathogenicity relies on a multitude of virulence factors (VFs). Identifying these factors is crucial for comprehending the molecular mechanisms driving bacterial pathogenesis and pinpointing potential targets for antivirulence strategies. While the identification of VFs has received extensive attention, there is still a lack of prediction from the perspective of VF classes. Moreover, most computational methods focus solely on sequence information for virulence proteins, neglecting spatial structure information. Here, a novel Structure-based Dual-driven Graph Transformer framework named SDGT is proposed to identify multiple distinct VFs by leveraging graph data structures of virulence proteins and sequence representations generated from a pretrained protein language model. By representing virulence proteins at both the atom and residue levels, SDGT adaptively and comprehensively learns a graph representation of protein structure through the utilization of self-attention pooling. The results of extensive experiments demonstrate that SDGT significantly enhances the classification performance, achieving an accuracy of 0.7623 on an independent test dataset, outperforming other sequence-based and structure-based methods. Moreover, cluster analysis of pathogen VF features learned by SDGT proves the excellent specificity and similarity feature learning power of the proposed model. The current analysis suggests that SDGT is an effective tool for identifying of VF classes.
abstract_zh: 细菌致病性依赖于多种毒力因子（virulence factors, VFs）。识别这些因子对于理解驱动细菌发病机制的分子机制以及确定抗毒力策略的潜在靶点至关重要。尽管VFs的识别已受到广泛关注，但从VF类别的角度进行预测仍存在不足。此外，大多数计算方法仅关注毒力蛋白的序列信息，忽视了空间结构信息。本文提出了一种名为SDGT的新型基于结构的双驱动图变换器框架（Structure-based Dual-driven Graph Transformer），通过利用毒力蛋白的图数据结构以及由预训练蛋白质语言模型生成的序列表示，来识别多种不同的VFs。通过在原子和残基水平上表示毒力蛋白，SDGT利用自注意力池化自适应且全面地学习蛋白质结构的图表示。大量实验结果表明，SDGT显著提升了分类性能，在独立测试数据集上达到了0.7623的准确率，优于其他基于序列和基于结构的方法。此外，对SDGT学习到的病原体VF特征的聚类分析证明了该模型在特异性和相似性特征学习方面的卓越能力。当前分析表明，SDGT是识别VF类别的有效工具。
